basis.projects_with: sphere average over the captured 8x8 equi-area directions
basis.storage: ScreenProbeRadianceSHAmbient = L0 RGB (R11G11B10); ScreenProbeRadianceSHDirectional = 4 channels x 2 texels per RGB channel (RGBA16F)
basis.flat_order: each sh array is 27 signed numbers: R0..R8, G0..G8, B0..B8
basis.sign: stored coefficients are signed; no clamp is applied to the stored data

formula.evaluate_sh_irradiance_source: SHCommon.ush EvaluateSHIrradiance clamps to zero; the decoder keeps the signed dot and separately reports the explicit display clamp

figure_legend.active_*: captured screenshot + every active placement dot; cyan uniform, orange adaptive
figure_legend.lobes_*: captured screenshot + the 10 focused projected response lobes; no all-active dot grid
figure_legend.visible_lobe: colored filled surface, depth-tested against the captured SceneDepthZ
figure_legend.xray_lobe: magenta outline: depth-occluded part of the same function lobe, drawn as an explicit x-ray function glyph; it is not a physical object
figure_legend.focus_markers: green cross = floor reference, magenta cross = arcade reference
figure_legend.rosettes: fixed-scale azimuth reduction of the same 162-direction clamped luminance

evidence.note: sphere-average radiance SH; D=4*EvaluateSHIrradiance; the exact convention maps constant radiance to itself.  The captured 8x8 equi-area quadrature leaves a few-percent residual in the higher bands; that is reported separately and is not treated as a decoder error.

limitations: The five roots are separate captures; probe sampling positions move with the captured TAA/probe jitter even for the fixed camera.
Nearest-reference matching is by world distance; it is not a claim that the two samples are the same physical location.
No shader-local blend weights, ray weights, or per-index dispatch tables are claimed; only captured resource bytes are decoded.
Stored values beyond the captured allocator count are stale and are not interpreted as active coefficients.
